mapper.select: select * from stock_position where user_id=#{userId} order by create_time desc
select * from stock_position where position_id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
select count(1)>0 from stock_position where user_id=#{userId} and stock_code=#{code}
mapper.update: update stock_position set cost_price=#{costPrice},quantity=#{quantity},stock_name=#{stockName},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where position_id=#{positionId} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from stock_position where position_id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: select user_id,total_assets from stock_account where user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into stock_account(user_id,total_assets,update_time) values(#{userId},#{totalAssets},sysdate()) on duplicate key update total_assets=#{totalAssets},update_time=sysdate()
